title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Null assertion highlight, Kotlin files only
summary: Fixes null assertion highlighting to exclude Java files, where !! is a boolean double-negation, not a Kotlin null-assertion operator.

highlights.title: Null Assertion Scope Fix
highlights.description: The !! highlight now applies only in Kotlin files — Java files no longer produce false positives from boolean double-negation expressions such as !!condition.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Null assertion highlighting (!! operator) no longer triggers in Java files, where !! is a boolean double-negation rather than a null-assertion operator.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: This is a focused single-fix release. No commands, settings, navigation behavior, or other UI changed since v1.17.9.
